messages.content: I need to settle the Raleigh hotels now that the Wednesday review runs until 8:30 p.m. Compare keeping one site hotel through departure with moving to an airport hotel Wednesday night.

Because your Thursday flight leaves RDU at 6:10 a.m., you need four hotel nights: Sunday through Wednesday. I found two workable structures. Cedar Park Suites near the supplier is $176 nightly for four nights, or $704 before tax. Breakfast is $18. Its standard Wednesday checkout is noon, so a three-night booking would leave you without a private room for the 7:00-8:30 p.m. review. Keeping the room Wednesday night solves that and avoids a move.

The Junction Hotel is seven minutes from the site. Sunday through Tuesday costs $194 nightly, with breakfast included, for $582 before tax. It will extend Wednesday checkout to 9:00 p.m. for $85. After the review, you would drive about 24 minutes to the RDU Gateway Hotel, where Wednesday night is $149 before tax. The split total is $816 before tax.
So the split is $112 more before tax. Include breakfast in the other comparison; I will eat at the hotel Monday through Wednesday.

Adding three breakfasts makes Cedar Park $758 before tax. The split remains $816 because Junction includes breakfast, narrowing the difference to $58. Taxes are estimated at $98.54 for Cedar Park and $105.68 across the two split bookings, giving estimated lodging totals of $856.54 and $921.68.
How much driving does the airport move actually save Thursday morning?

Cedar Park is about 31 minutes from RDU at the planned 3:45 a.m. departure. RDU Gateway is about six minutes away. The split saves roughly 25 minutes Thursday morning but adds the 24-minute drive after Wednesday's review, so total driving is nearly unchanged. Its advantage is being close to the terminal before the early flight, not reducing overall road time.
Spell out the luggage and receipt implications.

At Cedar Park, you unpack once and can leave luggage in the room during the audit and review. With the split, you would check out administratively Wednesday morning but retain the Junction room under the paid extension, return after the audit, conduct the review there, repack, and move around 8:40 p.m. The single stay produces one lodging folio with room, taxes, and breakfasts. The split produces a Junction folio containing three nights plus the day-use fee and a separate one-night RDU Gateway folio; that is one additional receipt and a clearer need to document the business reason for the move.

Do either of these have meaningful recreation amenities? I am traveling alone for work, so they should not drive this choice. For stays with my spouse, though, I want both a pool and a fitness facility; a hot tub is a bonus when it is available.

Cedar Park lists a fitness room but no pool. Junction lists an indoor pool and fitness room, while RDU Gateway lists a fitness room only; neither listing confirms a hot tub. I will leave those out of the work-trip ranking. The practical choice is Cedar Park: it is about $65 less after estimated tax, avoids a late hotel transfer and duplicate folios, and guarantees a private room for the review.
Before deciding, check whether Cedar Park will let me use the room for the review if I leave for the airport at 3:45 a.m., and whether that early departure changes the charged night.

Cedar Park confirmed that a four-night reservation keeps the room available through the standard Thursday checkout time, so the Wednesday evening review is permitted. Leaving at 3:45 a.m. does not remove or prorate the Wednesday-night charge. They can email the folio after departure, and the desk is staffed overnight. No booking has been made.
Then choose Cedar Park and give me the concise rationale and what still needs confirmation. Do not book yet.

Selected, not booked: Cedar Park Suites for four nights, Sunday through Wednesday, estimated at $856.54 including taxes and three breakfasts. It is about $65 less than the split arrangement, requires no Wednesday-night transfer, keeps your luggage in one room, provides a quiet private space for the 7:00-8:30 p.m. review, and yields one folio. The Thursday 3:45 a.m. departure still incurs the full Wednesday-night charge. Before booking, confirm the cancellable rate, exact taxes, breakfast posting method, overnight checkout procedure, parking charge, and that the folio will itemize all four nights and breakfasts.
